title: Tavily MCP Server
summary: Run Tavily's official MCP server through npx so your agent can search the web and extract page content with tavily-search and tavily-extract.
description: Tavily builds search for AI agents, and its tavily-mcp package adds tools such as tavily-search and tavily-extract. The agent gets ranked results with snippets and can pull the readable content of specific URLs.
It starts locally with npx and reads your key from TAVILY_API_KEY. An optional DEFAULT_PARAMETERS variable, a JSON string, sets defaults like search depth and result count.
useWhen: Check the latest version and changelog of a dependency
Extract the text of a documentation page into the conversation
Gather sources on a technical question before you decide
Verify a claim in a README against the vendor's own site

mcp.name: tavily
access: Sends search queries and page URLs to Tavily
Returns web content to the agent; no access to your files

example.prompt: Search for the current LTS version of Node and quote the release date.
example.result: The newest LTS line is listed on nodejs.org's releases page with its start date and end-of-life date. The agent cites the source URL beside each figure.

faq.question: Is there a hosted version?
faq.answer: Yes, Tavily also serves a remote endpoint at mcp.tavily.com that accepts OAuth or a Bearer key. This setup uses the local package.

faq.question: How do I limit result counts?
faq.answer: Set DEFAULT_PARAMETERS to a JSON string such as {"max_results": 5, "search_depth": "basic"}.
